## Personality

Simon Fletcher is known for his ability to accurately predict the weather. Following a major storm, others have come to place strong trust in his forecasts.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P17](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0017)_

## Relationships

### [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/milty-boulter--simon-fletcher.md)

Simon Fletcher is Milty Boulter's uncle through Milty's mother, who is Simon's sister. This familial bond establishes a direct maternal relation between the two.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011)_
